name: model-portfolio
description: Model Portfolio management platform - model creation, client account attachment, sharing, and money allocation / rebalance order generation.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend & npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/backend && npm run test --workspace=apps/frontend
